Operation: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field
Why defer: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Reproductive.
LGU/MAO action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Santa Ana due to rainfall of 37.6 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Santa Ana. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Santa Ana
Rainfall of 37.6 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:
🌧️ HARVEST ADVISORY — Santa Ana

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley

OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - San Agustin
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Reproductive.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.

Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Bagabag due to rainfall of 20.7 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Bagabag. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Bagabag
Rainfall of 20.7 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Kasibu due to rainfall of 20.8 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Kasibu. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Kasibu
Rainfall of 20.8 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:
🌧️ HARVEST ADVISORY — Kasibu

Rain is affecting harvest conditions. Delay harvesting if fields are wet. Use mechanical dryers to prevent grain spoilage.

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Quezon due to rainfall of 21.2 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Quezon. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Quezon
Rainfall of 21.2 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:
🌧️ HARVEST ADVISORY — Quezon

Rain is affecting harvest conditions. Delay harvesting if fields are wet. Use mechanical dryers to prevent grain spoilage.

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Cabarroguis due to rainfall of 21.8 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Cabarroguis. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Cabarroguis
Rainfall of 21.8 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley
